record.original_question: Let G be a bridgeless subcubic graph. If G is neither the Wagner graph nor the graph obtained from K_{3,3} by subdividing one edge, must chi_s(G) <= 9 hold?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 32. Let G be a subcubic graph. (a) [97] If G is bridgeless and is neither the Wagner graph nor the graph formed from the complete bipartite graph K3,3 by subdividing one edge, then χ_s(G) 6 9.

Let G be a subcubic bridgeless graph. If G is neither the Wagner graph nor the graph formed from K3,3 by subdiving an edge, then χ_s(G) 6 9. This is Conjecture 32(a), due to Hocquard, Lajou, and Luˇzar.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A graph is called subcubic if every vertex has degree at most 3, and bridgeless if it contains no cut-edge. A strong edge-coloring of a graph G is an assignment of colors to the edges of G such that any two edges that are either adjacent (sharing a common endpoint) or joined by an edge form an induced matching; equivalently, edges receiving the same color form an induced matching in G. The strong chromatic index χ_s(G) is the minimum number of colors in a strong edge-coloring of G.

The Wagner graph V_8 is the 8-vertex Möbius–Kantor-like graph obtained from the cycle on vertices v_0, v_1, ..., v_7 by adding the four "long" chords v_i v_{i+4} (indices mod 8). Let H denote the graph obtained from the complete bipartite graph K_{3,3} by subdividing exactly one edge with a single new vertex of degree 2.

Prove or disprove: For every bridgeless subcubic graph G that is isomorphic neither to the Wagner graph V_8 nor to H, one has χ_s(G) ≤ 9.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture, due to Hocquard, Lajou, and Lužar (2020/2022), asserts that every bridgeless subcubic graph other than the Wagner graph and the once-subdivided K_{3,3} has strong chromatic index at most 9. Andersen and Horák–Qing–Trotter proved the bound 10 for all subcubic graphs, and computational searches have not found counterexamples on more than 12 vertices, but the conjecture remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Between proper and strong edge-colorings of subcubic graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Hocquard, Lajou, Lužar conjecture: every bridgeless subcubic graph not isomorphic to Wagner or subdivided K_{3,3} has χ_s ≤ 9.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is stated as open by its proposers.

status_evidence.title: Between Proper and Strong Edge-Colorings of Subcubic Graphs (arXiv:2011.02175)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses strong edge-colorings of subcubic graphs and related conjectures including the 9-color conjecture for bridgeless subcubic graphs.
